algorithm: pi0-flow-DROID, pi0-FAST-DROID, PG-flow-DROID, PG-FAST-DROID, PG-FAST+-DROID, PG-FSQ-DROID, PG-Bin-DROID
arm: Franka Panda 7-DoF with Robotiq 2F-85 gripper (DROID platform)
success_criterion: continuous progress score [0,100] plus a binary pairwise preference label, aggregated via a task-aware Bradley-Terry ranking model
headline_metric: Pearson r and MMRV of the crowd-sourced ranking vs an exhaustive oracle ranking

human_data: none (policies are DROID-trained; RoboArena itself collects no new training data, only evaluation feedback)
